techniques.title: Field Marks
techniques.description: This study samples a seeded noise field on a grid and turns each sample into a short line or bar. Columns, rows, pitch, and maximum length change the density and scale; Bars changes the mark shape. A new seed changes the field while the palette recolors the same kind of composition.
techniques.markdown:
# Make a field of marks

This study samples a seeded noise field on a grid and turns each sample into a short line or bar. Columns, rows, pitch, and maximum length change the density and scale; Bars changes the mark shape. A new seed changes the field while the palette recolors the same kind of composition.

operations.description: An immutable row-major rectangular sequence of planar positions with explicit point counts and spacing.
An immutable seeded single-octave 2D gradient field with pure binary64 samples in [0,1]. Independently specified; not Processing noise compatibility.
Immutable ordered opaque sRGB8 palette sampled by a phase in cycles, with linear encoded-channel interpolation and fixed RGB24 quantization.

techniques.title: Path Marks
techniques.description: Seeded paths follow a sampled direction field. Steps controls their length and Step distance controls how far each move travels. Trace draws the paths themselves; switch it off to place perpendicular strokes along them and adjust Mark length. Recoloring leaves their geometry unchanged.
techniques.markdown:
# Draw field-guided paths

Seeded paths follow a sampled direction field. Steps controls their length and Step distance controls how far each move travels. Trace draws the paths themselves; switch it off to place perpendicular strokes along them and adjust Mark length. Recoloring leaves their geometry unchanged.

operations.description: An immutable row-major rectangular sequence of planar positions with explicit point counts and spacing.
An immutable seeded single-octave 2D gradient field with pure binary64 samples in [0,1]. Independently specified; not Processing noise compatibility.
Retain a finite two-dimensional trajectory by sampling an explicit gradient field at each evolving position and advancing a fixed distance. Reuse its positions and headings for different marks.

techniques.title: Placement Marks
techniques.description: This study proposes seeded circles and keeps only placements with room between them. Attempts gives the sampler more chances, while the radius interval and separation change what can fit. Radial source and Diamonds change the supplied proposal or the painted form.
techniques.markdown:
# Place separated forms

This study proposes seeded circles and keeps only placements with room between them. Attempts gives the sampler more chances, while the radius interval and separation change what can fit. Radial source and Diamonds change the supplied proposal or the painted form.

operations.description: Place differently sized circles from an explicit seed and finite proposal budget, retaining geometry for independent drawing.
Retain supplied circles in order when their radius-dependent exclusion test permits them alongside earlier accepted circles.

techniques.title: Lattice Marks
techniques.description: Paths claim cells on a square lattice in order. Paths and Moves set the amount of routing, while Dots and Grid switch the visible treatment. The palette follows each route in its generated order.
techniques.markdown:
# Grow occupied lattice routes

Paths claim cells on a square lattice in order. Paths and Moves set the amount of routing, while Dots and Grid switch the visible treatment. The palette follows each route in its generated order.

operations.description: Generate ordered retained cardinal cell paths whose cells are claimed by one call-local occupancy set.
Immutable ordered opaque sRGB8 palette sampled by a phase in cycles, with linear encoded-channel interpolation and fixed RGB24 quantization.

techniques.title: Band Marks
techniques.description: Seeded noise paths are drawn as connected bands or perpendicular ticks. Paths sets how many are made; Tolerance and Field scale shape which field values the paths accept. Stroke weight adjusts the painted marks, and Ticks changes their treatment.
techniques.markdown:
# Layer noise paths

Seeded noise paths are drawn as connected bands or perpendicular ticks. Paths sets how many are made; Tolerance and Field scale shape which field values the paths accept. Stroke weight adjusts the painted marks, and Ticks changes their treatment.

operations.description: Retain an attempt-bounded connected path whose accepted proposals remain within a strict scalar band around the starting noise value.

techniques.title: Branch Marks
techniques.description: A seeded endpoint-branch tree expands from one root or a small forest. Generations controls depth, Base weight tapers the root drawing, and Tip size controls the terminal dots. Binary changes the available child slots.
techniques.markdown:
# Grow endpoint branches

A seeded endpoint-branch tree expands from one root or a small forest. Generations controls depth, Base weight tapers the root drawing, and Tip size controls the terminal dots. Binary changes the available child slots.

operations.description: Retain a bounded breadth-first endpoint branch tree from an explicit root, portable seed, and ordered generation rules. It computes segment geometry and ancestry only.
Place differently sized circles from an explicit seed and finite proposal budget, retaining geometry for independent drawing.

techniques.title: Cut Branch Marks
techniques.description: A seeded line pool repeatedly cuts retained segments. Cuts gives it more opportunities to develop, while Cut angle controls the spread. Stroke weight and segment opacity change the accumulated drawing treatment.
techniques.markdown:
# Cut a line into branches

A seeded line pool repeatedly cuts retained segments. Cuts gives it more opportunities to develop, while Cut angle controls the spread. Stroke weight and segment opacity change the accumulated drawing treatment.

operations.description: Generate a retained ordered pool of branching segments by repeatedly cutting selected existing segments.

techniques.title: Loop Marks
techniques.description: Closed splines carry oriented tiles along their outlines. Tile scale resizes the tiles, and Outline weight adjusts the spline strokes. Enable Fans to fill the loops with triangles and adjust Fan opacity. Moved control offsets one control point on each loop in either mode; the supplied starting arrangement is fixed.
techniques.markdown:
# Draw closed loops

Closed splines carry oriented tiles along their outlines. Tile scale resizes the tiles, and Outline weight adjusts the spline strokes. Enable Fans to fill the loops with triangles and adjust Fan opacity. Moved control offsets one control point on each loop in either mode; the supplied starting arrangement is fixed.

operations.description: Retain a closed uniform Catmull-Rom spline from explicit planar controls with direct parameter and approximate distance queries.

techniques.title: Region Marks
techniques.description: A seeded quadrant partition makes a patchwork, then draws circles inside each region. Replacements and Selection fraction change the partition; Inset, Mark scale, and Nine marks control the decoration. More replacements can produce smaller cells.
techniques.markdown:
# Divide a surface into regions

A seeded quadrant partition makes a patchwork, then draws circles inside each region. Replacements and Selection fraction change the partition; Inset, Mark scale, and Nine marks control the decoration. More replacements can produce smaller cells.

operations.description: Generate an immutable, mutation-ordered sequence of equal-quadrant rectangular leaves from explicit seed, rectangle, replacement count and eligible-list fraction.

techniques.title: Panel Marks
techniques.description: Binary cuts split a panel layout over a bounded number of attempts. Axis policy chooses how cuts are oriented, while inset, outline weight, and Solid control the visible panel treatment. The seed determines the partition sequence.
techniques.markdown:
# Partition nested panels

Binary cuts split a panel layout over a bounded number of attempts. Axis policy chooses how cuts are oriented, while inset, outline weight, and Solid control the visible panel treatment. The seed determines the partition sequence.

operations.description: Generate retained ordered integer-cell rectangles by attempt-bounded binary cuts with random or longer-axis selection.

techniques.title: Cut Marks
techniques.description: Build a layout of colored panels, then cut or remove individual regions on the canvas.
techniques.markdown:
# Build retained cuts

Build a layout of colored panels, then cut or remove individual regions on the canvas.

 Cut rounds and Cut spread change the hierarchy; Inset and opacity change its treatment. Staggered adds an extra cut across a child region every third round.

Click a region on the canvas to select it. **Cut X** makes a vertical division through its midpoint; **Cut Y** makes a horizontal division. **Remove region** leaves an empty area. With the canvas focused, X, Y and Delete perform the same actions; Escape clears selection. The selection outline is an editing aid and is not part of the exported artwork.

Press **R** on the focused canvas for a new seed. Changing the seed, cut rounds, spread or staggered layout starts a fresh layout and clears manual cuts; changing the palette or inset keeps them. Undo restores the previous layout and its edits.

operations.description: Retain caller-directed unequal rectangle regions with stable identities and atomic single cuts/removals.
An immutable seeded single-octave 2D gradient field with pure binary64 samples in [0,1]. Independently specified; not Processing noise compatibility.

techniques.title: Polygon Marks
techniques.description: Seeded polygon proposals are accepted only when they avoid earlier placements. Proposals, aspect ratio, and maximum size control the input shapes, while outline weight and Shape select their appearance. The palette colors accepted forms in order.
techniques.markdown:
# Filter polygon placements

Seeded polygon proposals are accepted only when they avoid earlier placements. Proposals, aspect ratio, and maximum size control the input shapes, while outline weight and Shape select their appearance. The palette colors accepted forms in order.

operations.description: Ordered greedy filtering of supplied strictly convex polygon outlines using exact inclusive intersection; retained geometry and original proposal indices.
retained batch of seeded uniform planar points in one explicitly supplied triangle. It computes point geometry only.

techniques.title: Facet Marks
techniques.description: Seeded sites are triangulated into a Delaunay mesh. Sites changes the mesh scale, while Mode selects filled faces, wire edges, or grain. Grain density, wire weight, and fill opacity tune the selected treatment.
techniques.markdown:
# Turn sites into facets

Seeded sites are triangulated into a Delaunay mesh. Sites changes the mesh scale, while Mode selects filled faces, wire edges, or grain. Grain density, wire weight, and fill opacity tune the selected treatment.

operations.description: Produce owned exact planar Delaunay topology from an ordered finite binary64 site list and explicit deterministic work budget. It computes canonical unique vertices, input mappings, positive indexed faces, unique edges and final face incidence only; it has no random stream, renderer, palette, clipping, site sampler or draw side effect.
retained batch of seeded uniform planar points in one explicitly supplied triangle. It computes point geometry only.

techniques.title: Grain Marks
techniques.description: Seeded triangle samples become dots or short strokes. Density, mark size, and stroke weight set the texture; Distribution selects uniform, vertex, or edge concentration. Cell triangles samples seeded quadrant cells, while Strokes changes the marks.
techniques.markdown:
# Fill triangles with grain

Seeded triangle samples become dots or short strokes. Density, mark size, and stroke weight set the texture; Distribution selects uniform, vertex, or edge concentration. Cell triangles samples seeded quadrant cells, while Strokes changes the marks.

operations.description: retained batch of seeded uniform planar points in one explicitly supplied triangle. It computes point geometry only.
retained planar mapping of caller-provided unit-coordinate pairs through one explicitly supplied ordered triangle. It owns no random stream or distribution claim.
Generate an immutable, mutation-ordered sequence of equal-quadrant rectangular leaves from explicit seed, rectangle, replacement count and eligible-list fraction.

techniques.title: Pull Marks
techniques.description: Seeded scanlines are deformed by a radial pull. Radius and power define the influence, while Lines, Jitter, and Weight set the drawing density and character. The palette colors the resulting scanlines.
techniques.markdown:
# Pull scanlines around a center

Seeded scanlines are deformed by a radial pull. Radius and power define the influence, while Lines, Jitter, and Weight set the drawing density and character. The palette colors the resulting scanlines.

operations.description: Immutable ordered radial influences that sum inward power-profile displacements at the original point; may fold and self-intersect geometry.

techniques.title: Projection Marks
techniques.description: Parallel paths are projected through two discs in sequence. Radius controls their reach and Strength controls the projection amount. Lines and Weight change the drawn path family. The supplied starting arrangement is fixed; each projection acts on the result of the preceding disc.
techniques.markdown:
# Project paths around discs

Parallel paths are projected through two discs in sequence. Radius controls their reach and Strength controls the projection amount. Lines and Weight change the drawn path family. The supplied starting arrangement is fixed; each projection acts on the result of the preceding disc.

operations.description: Sequentially move supplied points outward toward the boundaries of ordered supplied discs.

techniques.title: Path Clip Marks
techniques.description: Seeded wandering paths are converted to segments and clipped against a notched boundary. Paths, Steps, and Wander shape the source motion; Notch floor changes the clipping region. Clipping removes portions outside the boundary without steering the paths.
techniques.markdown:
# Clip paths to a notch

Seeded wandering paths are converted to segments and clipped against a notched boundary. Paths, Steps, and Wander shape the source motion; Notch floor changes the clipping region. Clipping removes portions outside the boundary without steering the paths.

operations.description: Clip supplied segments to a simple concave polygon, retaining source identity and every positive-length interior or boundary interval.

techniques.title: Ramp Marks
techniques.description: A fixed dot field samples a stop ramp across the canvas or from its center. Spacing and dot size set the mark grid, Radial changes the sampling coordinate, and Radial spread changes how quickly colors move through the ramp.
techniques.markdown:
# Sample a color ramp

A fixed dot field samples a stop ramp across the canvas or from its center. Spacing and dot size set the mark grid, Radial changes the sampling coordinate, and Radial spread changes how quickly colors move through the ramp.

operations.description: Immutable noncyclic positioned RGB24 color stops with piecewise linear sampling and endpoint holds.

techniques.title: Warp Marks
techniques.description: A seeded field displaces pixels in a generated striped source. Strength controls the displacement distance, Scale changes the field, and Stripe changes the source artwork. The palette colors the source before the warp.
techniques.markdown:
# Warp generated stripes

A seeded field displaces pixels in a generated striped source. Strength controls the displacement distance, Scale changes the field, and Stripe changes the source artwork. The palette colors the source before the warp.

operations.description: Remap an owned packed ARGB8 raster through explicit source coordinates using edge-clamped bilinear interpolation.
Immutable seeded single-octave three-coordinate gradient field with pure binary64 samples in[0,1]; independent of Processing noise.

techniques.title: Blur Marks
techniques.description: This study first generates a seeded band image, then filters it with a bounded separable blur kernel. Radius changes the kernel reach and Stripe changes the source band width. Horizontal only restricts the filter to its horizontal pass; it is not a blend with another layer.
techniques.markdown:
# Blur generated bands

This study first generates a seeded band image, then filters it with a bounded separable blur kernel. Radius changes the kernel reach and Stripe changes the source band width. Horizontal only restricts the filter to its horizontal pass; it is not a blend with another layer.

operations.description: Normalize two caller-supplied one-dimensional kernels and filter a straight ARGB8 raster horizontally then vertically in premultiplied encoded RGB.

techniques.title: Profile Marks
techniques.description: A fixed profile becomes a shaded radial mesh. Form 0 selects a cylinder, 1 a waist, and 2 a pointed profile; Slices controls angular resolution, and Height and Radius set its proportions. Caps closes the ends where the selected form allows it.
techniques.markdown:
# Build a radial profile

A fixed profile becomes a shaded radial mesh. Form 0 selects a cylinder, 1 a waist, and 2 a pointed profile; Slices controls angular resolution, and Height and Radius set its proportions. Caps closes the ends where the selected form allows it.

operations.description: Generate an owned indexed-triangle radial surface from a caller-supplied ordered local axial radius profile, angular subdivision, independent endpoint closures, and explicit face bound. It computes retained local geometry, topology metadata, and flat unit normals only.

techniques.title: Annular Marks
techniques.description: A fixed annular mesh is controlled by outer and inner radius, depth, and angular slices. It always retains a central opening, so Inner radius must remain smaller than Outer radius. The palette colors the generated faces.
techniques.markdown:
# Build an annular solid

A fixed annular mesh is controlled by outer and inner radius, depth, and angular slices. It always retains a central opening, so Inner radius must remain smaller than Outer radius. The palette colors the generated faces.

operations.description: Generate an owned indexed-triangle closed annular solid from explicit inner and outer radii, two axial planes, angular subdivision, and a required face budget. It retains local positions, flat unit normals, face kinds, and angular-cell identity; it does not draw.

techniques.title: Depth Marks
techniques.description: A radial mesh is colored by a seeded three-dimensional noise sample. Radius, Height, and Slices set the form, while Depth sample chooses a slice through the field. The palette maps those field values onto the visible faces.
techniques.markdown:
# Shade a depth field mesh

A radial mesh is colored by a seeded three-dimensional noise sample. Radius, Height, and Slices set the form, while Depth sample chooses a slice through the field. The palette maps those field values onto the visible faces.

operations.description: Immutable seeded single-octave three-coordinate gradient field with pure binary64 samples in[0,1]; independent of Processing noise.

Generate an owned indexed-triangle radial surface from a caller-supplied ordered local axial radius profile, angular subdivision, independent endpoint closures, and explicit face bound. It computes retained local geometry, topology metadata, and flat unit normals only.

techniques.title: Spring Marks
techniques.description: Independent seeded bodies move toward targets for an explicit number of ticks. Bodies, Strength, Damping, and target radius change the simulation; Ticks selects a repeatable snapshot instead of running in wall time. The palette colors the settled or moving lines.
techniques.markdown:
# Snapshot spring motion

Independent seeded bodies move toward targets for an explicit number of ticks. Bodies, Strength, Damping, and target radius change the simulation; Ticks selects a repeatable snapshot instead of running in wall time. The palette colors the settled or moving lines.

operations.description: Advance an ordered independent target-spring state by one explicit logical step: target force, position using updated velocity, then velocity retention. State carries each body's position, velocity and coefficients. Native execution owns a mutable fixed-size batch with atomic steps and detached observations; no pointer, clock, RNG, renderer, topology or convergence guarantee.
